senses.gloss: severe, sharp, and needing urgent attention

definition_translations.zh_TW: 嚴重、劇烈且需要緊急處理的
definition_translations.ja_JP: 深刻で鋭く、緊急対応が必要な

senses.gloss: able to notice or understand things very well
senses.example: She has an acute understanding of customer behavior.

translations.th_TH: เฉียบแหลม; ว่องไว

example_translations.zh_TW: 她對顧客行為有敏銳的理解。
example_translations.ja_JP: 彼女は顧客行動を鋭く理解しています。
example_translations.ko_KR: 그녀는 고객 행동에 대해 예리하게 이해하고 있습니다.
example_translations.vi_VN: Cô ấy có sự thấu hiểu sắc bén về hành vi khách hàng.
example_translations.th_TH: เธอมีความเข้าใจอย่างเฉียบแหลมเกี่ยวกับพฤติกรรมลูกค้า

definition_translations.zh_TW: 能敏銳察覺或理解事物的
definition_translations.ja_JP: 物事に非常によく気づく、または理解できる
definition_translations.vi_VN: có khả năng nhận ra hoặc hiểu sự việc rất tốt
definition_translations.th_TH: สามารถสังเกตหรือเข้าใจสิ่งต่าง ๆ ได้ดีมาก

senses.gloss: forming an angle of less than 90 degrees
senses.example: The diagram shows an acute angle beside a right angle.

example_translations.zh_TW: 圖表顯示一個銳角位於直角旁邊。
example_translations.ja_JP: その図は直角の隣に鋭角を示しています。
example_translations.ko_KR: 그 도표는 직각 옆에 예각을 보여 줍니다.
example_translations.vi_VN: Sơ đồ cho thấy một góc nhọn bên cạnh một góc vuông.
example_translations.th_TH: แผนภาพแสดงมุมแหลมอยู่ข้างมุมฉาก

definition_translations.vi_VN: tạo thành một góc nhỏ hơn 90 độ
definition_translations.th_TH: ก่อให้เกิดมุมที่น้อยกว่า 90 องศา
